Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Kharagpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIT Kharagpur Research Associate positions is 31st August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in specific fields like Mining Engineering, Computer Science, AI, Data Science, IT, Geology, or Applied Geology, along with at least two first-author SCI journal publications in relevant domains.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate post is 35 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Research Associate position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 67,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy announced for the Research Associate post in the IIT Kharagpur recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for the IIT Kharagpur Research Associate jobs?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Kharagpur Research Associate recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website or the provided application link.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Research Associate position at IIT Kharagpur is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Kharagpur located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur is located in Kharagpur, West Bengal.

faq.question: Q10. What are the key research areas mentioned in the qualification criteria?
faq.answer: The key research areas include Mine Planning and Automation, Orebody Intelligence, Ore Geology, Critical Minerals, REEs, Integrated Gold Exploration Targeting System, Automated Underground Mine Design, Integrated Planning to Production System, and Hyperspectral Core Scanning towards Quantitative Mineralogy.
